prompt: Tell us about your experience/knowledge/interest in the crypto space (either personal or professional)
answer: I am a Solidity/DeFi engineer with 3 years of hands-on experience building and shipping on Ethereum, Avalanche C-Chain, and Base. Professionally, I focus on DeFi mechanisms and on-chain finance. Earlier in my career I built a lending/borrowing platform that invests against Uniswap v3 LP positions at a time when public research on v3 was still limited, and I have also integrated projects with Uniswap v2 and Pharaoh Exchange.

More recently, I designed and implemented a blockchain-based payments solution for a content sharing platform (anonymized). My scope spanned smart contracts, security reviews, testing and optimization, integration with off-chain services, and payment-flow redesign (including database changes). My development toolchain includes Hardhat and Foundry (Forge/Anvil). Off-chain, I use TypeScript with ethers.js and viem; for account-abstraction UX I employ Dynamic (e.g., embedded wallets, passkey/social sign-in, wallet linking, session keys) and Biconomy for gasless/sponsored transactions and smart account orchestration.

Security and reliability are core to my work. I apply role-based access control, strict parameter validation, separation of external vs. internal functions, and reentrancy protection, with attention to storage and memory safety. I use Slither and Mythril for static analysis and Echidna for property-based fuzzing. I also integrate Chainalysis blacklisted address checks when compliance gates are required.

For data and automation, I integrate Chainlink Price Oracles and Chainlink Automation for stop-loss and take-profit checks with freshness windows and decimals normalization, and I use Chainlink VRF when verifiable randomness is needed. Where upgradeability is warranted, I use proxy patterns with EIP-1967 storage slots, initializer/version guards, and storage gaps, while carefully managing storage layout to avoid collisions.

I care deeply about gas efficiency and maintainability. I researched gas optimization in Solidity at the master’s level, with practical emphasis on struct packing, minimizing SLOAD/SSTORE, and preferring calldata over memory when possible. I balance optimizations with clarity and correctness, noting that recent compiler improvements mitigate some historical pitfalls.

Personally, my interests center on AMMs and liquidity management, practical on-chain automation, and improving crypto UX (e.g., account abstraction flows and relaying). I keep up with protocol design changes and security post-mortems to evolve patterns and checks in my work.

I also actively participate as a user in the crypto ecosystem, including platforms such as Arena Social, Salvor.io, OpenSea, and many other DeFi applications. This hands-on experience informs my product and security decisions and keeps me current with real-world UX and on-chain patterns.
